description: The Universal Fairness Skill entry point. Wraps any agent wallet (Coinbase Agentic Wallet, AgentCash, ATXP, 1Pay.ing, …) with a refuse-to-overpay safety check. Call BEFORE settling any HTTP 402 / x402 / MPP quote. Canonical inputs: `slug` (the indexed ARI service slug), `amount_usd` (the quoted price in US dollars), and `unit` (the unit code, e.g. tokens). Legacy aliases `url`, `amountMicros`, and `amount_micros` are accepted and mapped internally for backward compatibility. Returns `{ verdict: 'fair' | 'stretched' | 'overpriced' | 'unknown', reason, suggestedMax, evidenceUrl }`. Refuse to settle on `overpriced`; surface the warning and ask consent on `stretched`; settle on `fair`.
name: prepay_verdict
title: Universal pre-payment fairness check
